screening_decisions.reason: Primary cross‑sectional diagnostic accuracy study evaluating multiple serum biomarkers (HE4, CA125) and composite algorithms (ROMA, RMI) against histology in women with a pelvic mass – directly matches the selection criteria.
Prospective cross‑sectional study assessing HE4, CA125, and ROMA for differentiating ovarian cancer from benign disease and endometriosis, using histopathology as reference – eligible.
Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study of the IOTA ADNEX ultrasound‑based model (with/without CA125) compared with surgical pathology – meets inclusion criteria.
Retrospective audit of CA125 testing in a large clinical cohort, reporting diagnostic performance against histology – a cross‑sectional diagnostic test accuracy study.
External validation of the ADNEX model and comparison with other diagnostic rules, using pathology as reference – fits the protocol.
Systematic review/meta‑analysis, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study; reviews are excluded by the selection criteria.
Cross‑sectional study calculating several RMI scores (1‑4) and reporting sensitivity/specificity against histology – directly relevant.
Large prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy trial of HE4, CA125 and ROMA, with histopathology as reference – eligible.
Prospective evaluation of HE4, CA125 and ROMA in benign, borderline and malignant disease, using histology – meets criteria.
Systematic review of symptom data; does not present primary diagnostic test accuracy data for biomarkers or imaging.
Systematic review/meta‑analysis rather than a primary diagnostic study; excluded by protocol.
Epidemiological overview of cancer incidence/mortality; not a diagnostic accuracy study of ovarian cancer tests.
Prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy study of the ADNEX multivariable model with histology reference – aligns with selection criteria.
Retrospective diagnostic study comparing several biomarkers/algorithms against histology in pre‑ and post‑menopausal women – eligible.
Prospective case‑control diagnostic accuracy study of HE4, CA125 and ROMA versus pathology – fits inclusion criteria.
Diagnostic and prognostic evaluation of HE4 and ROMA in a large cohort with histological confirmation – meets criteria.
Prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy study comparing IOTA ultrasound strategies and RMI against histology – directly relevant.
Development and validation of an RMI combining CA125, ultrasound and menopausal status with pathology reference – eligible.
Molecular/clinical study characterising HE4 expression and its diagnostic potential; includes assessment against tissue pathology – qualifies as diagnostic accuracy research.
Prospective diagnostic accuracy study of three biomarkers/algorithm in pre‑ and post‑menopausal women with histological confirmation – fits criteria.
Prospective study measuring HE4 and CA125 pre‑operatively and comparing with surgical histology – eligible.
Diagnostic accuracy investigation of HE4, CA125 and ROMA in a case‑control cohort with pathology reference – meets inclusion.
Large prospective validation of IOTA simple ultrasound rules and RMI against histology – directly matches the selection criteria.
Cross‑sectional diagnostic test accuracy study evaluating ROMA (combination of HE4, CA125 and menopausal status) against histopathology in symptomatic women with ovarian masses.
